question: How does conceptual worship lead to resting in the supreme reality?
premises: Worshippers apprehend properties shining within their own concepts.
Skill in those conceptualized properties can mature.
The property-bearer possesses the fullness of all properties.
inference: Through skill in the properties appearing within their concepts, worshippers come to rest upon the property-bearer as non-different and full of all properties.
uncertainties: abhedena may indicate identity, non-separation, or non-difference in contemplation; the verse does not force a single technical reading.
plain_english: Through their skill in the properties that shine within their own concepts, they come to rest upon the bearer of those properties as non-different and filled with the fullness of all properties.
